_about: Graham Wallas (1858-1932), political psychologist and a founder of the LSE: Our Social Heritage (London: George Allen and Unwin, first published 1921), raw IA OCR, clean 0.91. Held: Human Nature in Politics (1908), because the IA copy is the post-war edition with A. L. Rowse's foreword. Wanted: The Great Society (1914) and The Art of Thought (1926) in pre-1931 printings. US public domain. No uids minted.
